note: The closest thing to a textbook ICP match in this batch. He trades the financial markets, has enough time freedom to relocate to Lisbon and keep working, funds an in-person PT four times a week and is being referred to another one abroad - so successful and income are both clearly met, and he raised no price objection of any kind when $6,000 and $9,000 were quoted. Good-to-great is explicit: he opened by rejecting the problem frame with 'I would say I'm in a good place' and wants the last increment of a cut he has already nearly completed. The deconditioned exclusion plainly does not apply - four training days a week, six months of calisthenics, approx 155 lb. The one miss is neglected_health, and it is a miss in his favour rather than a disqualifier: health is the area he is actively tending, not the one he has let slide, which puts him slightly above the stated archetype instead of below it. Recording it as a miss matters for the rollup, because it shows the stated ICP describes someone who has neglected their health while the best-qualified prospect here has not.
